CLOUD REVIEWER seat for PR #2636 of tvofi/heatpump_optimizer, at head 4e1c57d5af1326cd61578d3bbf8751f7865a4ffb. Bus nonce: 9329e3e04f3dab9017782b1f82a8fc34. Never send push notifications.
Setup: `git fetch --unshallow --tags origin`. The toolchain (venv python, node, gh) is on PATH from the environment. Run anything heavy in the background with Monitor and no timeout.
Role: read dev/governance/roles/fix-review.md and its rules from main, and follow them exactly. Fetch the PR head with `git fetch origin 4e1c57d5af1326cd61578d3bbf8751f7865a4ffb`; the PR body is in the PR. Verify each claim adversarially: mutate the fix and check the tests fail, and check every figure in the body at this head. Check that it merges with origin/main (`git merge-tree --write-tree`) and read CI on this head from the check-runs API.
Output: in a fresh directory of your own (`W=$(mktemp -d)`), write verdict.md, whose first line is exactly `Fix review: merge 4e1c57d5af1326cd61578d3bbf8751f7865a4ffb` or `Fix review: blocked 4e1c57d5af1326cd61578d3bbf8751f7865a4ffb <class>: <reason>` (no brackets; the class is lower-case letters and dashes), in the format the role file gives, then a blank line, then `bus-nonce: 9329e3e04f3dab9017782b1f82a8fc34`; put the evidence in `ev/` beside it. Do NOT run bus.sh: its dispatch record lives on the orchestrator's machine, which publishes the verdict there (cloud_relay.sh). Return the verdict on a probe ref, and push nothing else; this builds one parentless commit with a private index and touches no branch of your checkout: `R=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel); G=$(git rev-parse --absolute-git-dir); mkdir -p $W/pr && cp -r $W/verdict.md $W/ev $W/pr/ && cd $W/pr && T=$(GIT_DIR=$G GIT_INDEX_FILE=$W/idx GIT_WORK_TREE=$W/pr sh -c 'git add -A -f . && git write-tree') && C=$(GIT_DIR=$G git -c user.name=seat -c user.email=seat@users.noreply.github.com commit-tree $T -m "verdict 2636 4e1c57d5af1326cd61578d3bbf8751f7865a4ffb") && git -C $R push -q origin $C:refs/heads/probe/rev-2636-9329e3e0`. That ref is the return signal. Do not post comments, approve or merge.
Never write to any branch except your return refs. Never work around a hook or a refusal; report it in your result instead.

Fix reviewer for PR #2636, group R10-FLY-NO-FOOTERS, DELTA review, head 4e1c57d5af1326cd61578d3bbf8751f7865a4ffb. Sonnet. The train's carry refused to carry it: the main merge a7cf60cf folded main's edits into files this PR also touches (tools/policy/policy_lint.mjs, field_coverage.mjs, tools/pr/*, .claude/settings.json). Review only the delta: git diff 328e222f 4e1c57d5. Follow dev/governance/roles/fix-review.md exactly, from a detached worktree at the head. Use the finder harness the group brief names, never the fixer harness. A red nightly-status grades main and is not this PR unless its diff reaches what that check reads. Your ev/ MUST contain a file holding the full 40-hex head sha (ev/HEAD.txt), or the relay refuses the verdict.

Verify:
(1) git diff 328e222f 4e1c57d5 is exactly main's changes since the old base. Every hunk of this PR's own change survives unaltered, and no main hunk is dropped. Check each overlapping file hunk by hunk.
(2) The merged files still do what the PR claims at the new head. Run policy_lint's self-test and fixtures, field_coverage, prepr's attribution fixtures (attribution.md refused, good-claude-ai.md accepted), and ref_privacy and cloud_dispatch self-tests.
(3) CI at 4e1c57d5 is green on the required checks, including policy-docs, with one bulk read.
